title: The Skeleton Legion
story: In the crypt beneath the old castle, skeleton soldiers rattle to life and march out in 5 perfect rows of 8! Mr 6 raises his enchanted shield — one mighty shield-bash sends exactly 10 skeletons clattering back to sleep.
question: How many shield-bashes does Mr 6 need to defeat the whole legion?
hint: First count the legion: 5 rows of 8 skeletons. Then count by 10s until you've knocked them all down.
victory: BASH! BASH! BASH! BASH! Forty skeletons tumble into neat, peaceful piles. Mr 6 tucks them each back into their tombs and tiptoes out, locking the crypt door behind him.
